from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(f"- {line}", font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.4).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.5)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (6x6 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                # Offset to the right side of the screen
                x = 1.0 + j * 1.0
                y = 2.2 - i * 1.0
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section3Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Setup layout with title and lecture lines
        self.setup_layout(
            "The Feedback Mechanics: 243 Possible Universes",
            [
                "Every guess returns one of 243 possible color patterns.",
                "Each pattern acts as a filter for the word list.",
                "We can visualize these patterns as buckets for words."
            ]
        )

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(YELLOW))
        
        # Display the word 'TRACE' with gray boxes
        word_trace = "TRACE"
        trace_boxes = VGroup()
        for i, char in enumerate(word_trace):
            box = Square(side_length=0.7, fill_color="#808080", fill_opacity=1, stroke_color=WHITE)
            letter = Text(char, font_size=36, color=WHITE)
            trace_boxes.add(VGroup(box, letter).arrange(ORIGIN))
        
        trace_boxes.arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.1)
        self.place_in_area(trace_boxes, "B1", "B6", scale_factor=1.0)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(trace_boxes))
        self.wait(1)
        
        # Mathematical sequence '3 x 3 x 3 x 3 x 3 = 243'
        math_seq = Text("3 x 3 x 3 x 3 x 3 = 243", font_size=32, color=WHITE)
        self.place_in_area(math_seq, "C1", "C6", scale_factor=1.0)
        
        self.play(Write(math_seq))
        self.wait(2)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(
            self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(YELLOW)
        )
        
        # Draw a grid of 243 tiny white empty squares (buckets)
        buckets = VGroup()
        rows_count = 9
        cols_count = 27 # 9 * 27 = 243
        for _ in range(243):
            buckets.add(Square(side_length=0.1, stroke_width=1, stroke_color=WHITE))
        
        buckets.arrange_in_grid(rows=rows_count, cols=cols_count, buff=0.05)
        self.place_in_area(buckets, "D1", "F6", scale_factor=0.95)
        
        self.play(FadeOut(trace_boxes), FadeOut(math_seq))
        self.play(Create(buckets), run_time=2)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(YELLOW)
        )
        
        # Animate a stream of words falling into buckets
        falling_words_list = ["CRANE", "SLATE", "ADIEU", "STARE", "AUDIO"]
        falling_word_mobs = VGroup(*[Text(w, font_size=14, color=WHITE) for w in falling_words_list])
        
        # Position words at the top (near row A) to start falling
        for i, word_mob in enumerate(falling_word_mobs):
            self.place_at_grid(word_mob, f"A{i+1}")
        
        # Animate falling into the grid area
        falling_animations = []
        for i, word_mob in enumerate(falling_word_mobs):
            # Target a random-ish bucket location
            target_pos = buckets[10 * (i+1)].get_center()
            falling_animations.append(word_mob.animate.move_to(target_pos).set_opacity(0))
            
        self.play(AnimationGroup(*[FadeIn(w) for w in falling_word_mobs], lag_ratio=0.2))
        self.play(AnimationGroup(*falling_animations, lag_ratio=0.1), run_time=2)
        
        # Scale up one bucket (Green-Gray-Yellow-Gray-Gray)
        # We simulate the bucket by creating a 5-box pattern
        big_bucket_pattern = VGroup()
        colors = ["#6AAA64", "#808080", "#C9B458", "#808080", "#808080"]
        for color in colors:
            big_bucket_pattern.add(Square(side_length=0.4, fill_color=color, fill_opacity=1, stroke_color=WHITE))
        big_bucket_pattern.arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.05)
        
        # Create 5 words inside or near the revealed bucket
        inside_words = VGroup(
            Text("TREAD", font_size=20),
            Text("TRAMS", font_size=20),
            Text("TRAPS", font_size=20),
            Text("TRACK", font_size=20),
            Text("TRASH", font_size=20)
        ).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.2)
        
        zoom_group = VGroup(big_bucket_pattern, inside_words).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.3)
        self.place_in_area(zoom_group, "B1", "E6", scale_factor=1.2)
        
        self.play(buckets.animate.set_opacity(0.2))
        self.play(FadeIn(big_bucket_pattern), Write(inside_words))
        self.wait(3)

        # Cleanup
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(WHITE))
        self.wait(1)

    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):

    def construct(self):
        title = "The Wordle Puzzle: A Search for Information"
        lines = [
            'Wordle is a search for a hidden five-letter word.',
            'Each guess reduces the list of 2,300 potential suspects.',
            'The goal is maximizing information gained from every guess.'
        ]
        self.setup_layout(title, lines)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Display 5 empty gray (#808080) squares in the center.
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(YELLOW))
        
        squares = VGroup(*[Square(side_length=0.6, color="#808080", stroke_width=4) for _ in range(5)])

        self.place_in_area(squares, "C2", "C5")

        self.wait(1)

            self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(YELLOW)
        )

        # Cloud representation: ~150 dots and a few labels to simulate 2300 without lag
        cloud_dots = VGroup()
        for _ in range(150):
            dot = Dot(radius=0.015, color="#FFFFFF", fill_opacity=0.4)
            # Scatter within the grid area A1-F6
            x_pos = np.random.uniform(0.5, 5.5)
            y_pos = np.random.uniform(-2.8, 2.2)
            dot.move_to([x_pos, y_pos, 0])
            cloud_dots.add(dot)

        cloud_labels = VGroup()
        word_list = ["REBUT", "SCARE", "THOSE", "PLATE", "LIGHT"]
        for _ in range(12):
            lbl = Text(np.random.choice(word_list), font_size=10, color="#FFFFFF", fill_opacity=0.3)

            y_pos = np.random.uniform(-2.8, 2.2)
            lbl.move_to([x_pos, y_pos, 0])
            cloud_labels.add(lbl)

        # Magnifying glass
        mag_circle = Circle(radius=0.3, color="#FFFFFF", stroke_width=3)
        mag_handle = Line(
            mag_circle.point_at_angle(-45*DEGREES), 
            mag_circle.point_at_angle(-45*DEGREES) + [0.3, -0.3, 0], 
            color="#FFFFFF", stroke_width=3
        )
        magnifying_glass = VGroup(mag_circle, mag_handle)
        self.place_at_grid(magnifying_glass, "A1")

        self.play(FadeIn(cloud_dots), FadeIn(cloud_labels), run_time=1)
        
        # Search path
        search_path = [self.grid["A5"], self.grid["D2"], self.grid["F6"]]
        for target in search_path:
            self.play(magnifying_glass.animate.move_to(target), run_time=0.8, rate_func=smooth)
        
        self.play(FadeOut(magnifying_glass))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Flip the 5 squares to reveal a pattern: Green (#00FF00), Gray (#808080), Yellow (#FFFF00), Gray, Gray.

        self.play(
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(YELLOW)
        )

        target_colors = ["#00FF00", "#808080", "#FFFF00", "#808080", "#808080"]
        reveal_anims = []
        for i, (sq, col) in enumerate(zip(squares, target_colors)):
            reveal_anims.append(sq.animate.set_fill(col, opacity=1.0).set_color(col).rotate(PI, axis=RIGHT))

        # Words fading
        cluster_size = 10
        all_cloud_indices = list(range(len(cloud_dots)))
        np.random.shuffle(all_cloud_indices)
        keep_indices = all_cloud_indices[:cluster_size]
        fade_indices = all_cloud_indices[cluster_size:]

        dots_to_fade = VGroup(*[cloud_dots[i] for i in fade_indices])
        dots_to_keep = VGroup(*[cloud_dots[i] for i in keep_indices])

        self.play(
            *reveal_anims,
            FadeOut(dots_to_fade),
            FadeOut(cloud_labels),
            run_time=2
        )

        # Highlight cluster
        self.play(
            dots_to_keep.animate.set_color(YELLOW).scale(3).set_opacity(1),
            Flash(dots_to_keep, color=YELLOW, flash_radius=0.5)
        )
        
        self.wait(3)
